provenance: Emoji that function as ordinary written shorthand rather than as slang or expression — the quiet workhorses of group chats, calendars, listings and logistics, where a glyph replaces a word to save space. Under-documented precisely because it is mundane.

🎂.sense: a birthday, as a calendar entry
🎂.gloss: Stands in for the date itself in group chats and shared calendars.

🕐.gloss: Clock faces are used to float a meeting time; the specific hand position is almost never meaningful.

📅.gloss: A request to move a conversation into a calendar.

🗓️.gloss: Distinguished in practice from 📅 by implying something repeating.

⏰.gloss: Confirms someone will be prompted, rather than describing a clock.

🚗.sense: I'll drive, or I'm en route

🚂.gloss: Travel-mode declaration in the same register.

🛴.gloss: Used for micromobility generally, not the specific vehicle.

🅿️.gloss: Property listings and event details use this as a feature bullet.

🛏️.gloss: Standard in rental and property listings: the glyph plus a number.

📐.gloss: Prefixes a square-metre or square-foot figure.

🐾.gloss: A listing feature marker; also used for animal-related accounts generally.

🚿.gloss: Amenity listing in accommodation and gym descriptions.

📶.gloss: Used to praise or complain about connectivity, and as an amenity marker.

🔌.gloss: A genuine selling point in cafe and coworking reviews — quite separate from the gated slang sense recorded elsewhere in this dataset.

♿.gloss: Stands for accessibility as a whole, not only wheelchair users.

🤒.gloss: The standard 'not coming in today' glyph.

🤧.sense: working from home with a cold

💊.gloss: The ordinary, non-illicit sense, in health-tracking and family chats.

🩺.gloss: Calendar shorthand for seeing a doctor.

🧺.gloss: Household chore notation in shared-living chats.

🧹.gloss: Chore-rota shorthand, distinct from the commit-message 'cleanup' sense.

🛒.gloss: Introduces a list of items to buy.

💸.gloss: Spending or an unexpected cost, in personal-finance chat.

📦.sense: a parcel or a delivery update
📦.gloss: One of the highest-frequency practical emoji, tracking things in transit.

📬.gloss: Prompting someone to look at their email.

🥵.gloss: The literal thermal reading, still the dominant one in weather talk.

🌧️.gloss: Weather as an explanation rather than a description.

🔑.gloss: Moving house, lending a flat, granting permissions.

🪑.gloss: Table or seat booking confirmation — a mundane sense entirely unlike the absurdist chair meme.

🍽️.gloss: The practical sense, distinct from the 'she ate' compliment.

☕.gloss: A social proposal, and the least committal form of meeting invitation there is.

🔋.gloss: Explaining in advance why one may go silent.

📵.gloss: Announcing being offline or in a no-phone setting.
